selection_logic: Evidence audit must PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS.
Warning-only audits are disclosed and receive a conviction penalty.
Master portfolio decision must mark the company ELIGIBLE.
Expected return must clear the master portfolio threshold.
Evidence confidence is capped below certainty.
Position sizing uses opportunity, evidence confidence, expected return, volatility and risk quality.
Sector concentration has a 25% soft penalty and a stated hard limit.
The prototype is fully invested; cash is not an allocation option.
The completed portfolio receives a separate risk review.

cash_policy.reason: Prototype policy is fully invested; market context changes selection and sizing, not cash allocation.

benchmark.name: S&P 500 Index
benchmark.purpose: The S&P 500 is the reference index for assessing the prototype's future paper-portfolio performance.

performance_comparison.reason: A benchmark comparison begins only after a paper portfolio has recorded its construction date, holdings and subsequent prices.
performance_comparison.method: Compare like-for-like total returns, before any claim of outperformance.

valuation_time_horizon.label: 5-year DCF forecast period
valuation_time_horizon.disclosure: The valuation gap is model-implied over the stated DCF forecast period. It is not a guaranteed return by that date.
